device_math_notes: Host receives only shapes/dtypes/theta, computes tile and core counts, passes scalar theta and launches one exclusive branch. Device builds frequencies anew from theta. Generic log2/exp2 coefficients and Q53/Q61 guard bits describe a numerical algorithm, not stored RoPE outputs. The 32-entry generic exp2 table is generated on Device during every invocation; it is not supplied by Host or persisted between calls. Frequencies are rounded to FP32 before FP32 angles/trig/rotation. No input tensor is read by Host. Shape branches depend on alignment, working-set and parallelism. Position-zero copy implements the specified exact identity. In-call trig reuse is confined to one core and current positions; no cross-invocation state or global workspace. Final candidate generates the generic 32-entry exp2 table on the Device scalar pipe using Q61 guard bits, then splits it into FP32 high/low parts for vector evaluation; no compiled table of RoPE frequencies or rotation results exists.
